summary: The Asheville Quilt Guild is a 501(c)(3) membership club founded in 1988 with over 300 members, meeting monthly (3rd Tuesday) plus a first-Tuesday board meeting, with programs, committees, a newsletter, and a buddy system pairing new members with a returning 'friend'. The quilt show unit itself (indices 309) is the guild's annual 3-day public exhibition/fundraiser rather than a membership meeting, but it is organized and staffed by this same real, persistent club of quilters.

evidence.note: Listing describes a 3-day exhibition (300+ quilts, vendor hall, demos) organized by the Asheville Quilt Guild, with no membership language of its own since it's the guild's public show.
Guild 'About' page: 501(c)(3) with over 300 members, founded 1988 with a charter membership of 60, diverse and growing membership.
Meets on the 3rd Tuesday of every month (alternating day/evening schedule), with a program each meeting (clinics, speakers) and separate board meetings on the first Tuesday.
Guild has a formal join/renew process (online form, dues, $5 membership pin) confirming a real dues-paying membership structure.
Guild has a standing committee listing, indicating an ongoing organizational structure typical of an established club rather than an ad hoc event.
